description: This file defines the CustomerOptionService interface, which extends a generic service interface for entity operations related to CustomerOption objects. It declares methods for listing options by store and language, saving or updating options, and retrieving options by code within a merchant store context.

classes.name: CustomerOptionService
classes.description: An interface for managing customer options within a store, providing methods for listing, saving, updating, and retrieving options by code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of CustomerOption objects based on the specified store and language, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists or updates a CustomerOption entity, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOption based on the store and an option code.
